about_brief: I’m a Computer Science and Business Information Management student at UC Irvine, graduating in 2028. My experience spans data cleaning, machine learning, and building data pipelines through research and personal projects.
personal: Outside of school and research, I like hiking, exploring new places, and having friends over for something I’ve cooked.
focus_ml: I’m drawn to projects where a model helps answer a concrete question. In research, that has meant classifying papers; in PitchVision, it means exploring how soccer teams react when possession changes. I’m especially interested in preparing the data, testing an approach, and understanding where it falls short.
focus_data: I like taking scattered, inconsistent records and making them useful. My work has involved collecting data, cleaning and validating it, and organizing it for analysis. I’m interested in both sides: building reliable data workflows and using them to answer a meaningful question.
stack_data: PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Power BI
role_one_summary: Built an NLP pipeline to classify 600+ research papers using TF-IDF and logistic regression, achieving 87% accuracy. Analyzed model performance and documented the methods and findings. Also prepared and validated datasets for RAG financial-forecasting research.
role_one_stack: Python, TF-IDF, Logistic regression, NLP, RAG
role_two_summary: Built web-scraping and OCR pipelines to turn unstructured competition records into clean datasets. Standardized and validated 200,000+ athlete records, then modeled longitudinal data and ran statistical analyses to study athlete participation patterns.
role_two_stack: Python, pandas, Regex, OCR, Web scraping
projects_intro: Things I’ve been working on, from raw data to something useful.
ginseng_summary: Turning website data into reliable reporting tables and Power BI dashboards.
ginseng_problem: The website collects useful data, but much of it goes unused. It needs to be cleaned and organized before it can help answer business questions.
ginseng_approach: I’m building a pipeline to collect website records, check for missing or duplicate data, and transform them into reporting tables. Airflow coordinates the workflow, with errors logged so failed records can be corrected and retried.
ginseng_output: Power BI dashboards for sales, refunds, products, tickets, and customer activity. This portfolio demonstrates the workflow and reporting structure without displaying business figures.
photos_intro: Hiking, cooking, and places I’ve been.
pitch_summary: A computer vision project exploring how soccer teams react when possession changes, using player tracking and spatial data from match footage.
pitch_details: The pipeline detects and tracks players, then converts detections into pitch coordinates. Current work focuses on measuring transition moments through possession duration, ball-recovery time, player movement, and immediate post-turnover actions.
datathon_summary: An anomaly-detection project investigating unusual reporting behavior in more than one million crime records.
datathon_details: Cleaned invalid values and engineered reporting-delay features. Evaluated Local Outlier Factor and Isolation Forest, flagging 3% of records with anomalous reporting behavior and documenting the implications for data quality. An anomaly flag was a signal for review, not proof of an incorrect record.
